privacidade.meta_description: Trem Forge platform privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data, in line with Brazil's LGPD.
privacidade.hero_subtitle: How Trem Forge collects, uses, and protects your personal data, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).
privacidade.s1_body: Trem Forge is the controller of the personal data processed through this site and platform, under Brazilian Law No. 13,709/2018 (LGPD). This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and what rights you have over it.
privacidade.s2_intro: We collect different categories of data, depending on how you use the site:
privacidade.s2_li1_text: name, email, and password (stored hashed, never in plain text), when you create an account;
privacidade.s2_li2_text: name, email, phone, and project description, when you submit a request form;
privacidade.s2_li3_text: processed directly by Mercado Pago (BRL) or Stripe (USD) — Trem Forge does not store credit card numbers;
privacidade.s2_li4_text: messages sent to the AI assistant built into the site, processed via the Anthropic API;
privacidade.s2_li5_text: IP address, device type, pages visited, and usage events, collected via Google Analytics (GA4) and our own cookies;
privacidade.s2_li6_text: transactional emails (account confirmation, password recovery, purchase notifications) sent via Resend, and verification SMS sent via Comtele.
privacidade.s3_title: 3. What we use your data for and legal basis
privacidade.table_r1_c1: Create and maintain your account on the platform
privacidade.table_r3_c1: Respond to the project form and provide support
privacidade.table_r4_c1: Send transactional emails and password recovery
privacidade.table_r5_c1: Improve the site and understand usage (analytics)
privacidade.table_r6_c1: Comply with tax and legal obligations
privacidade.table_r6_c2: Compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 7, II)
privacidade.s4_title: 4. Who we share your data with
privacidade.s4_intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share only what's necessary with processors that help us provide the service, each subject to its own privacy policy:
privacidade.s4_li2_text: — processing of messages sent to the AI chat;
privacidade.s4_li6: Public authorities, when required by law or court order.
privacidade.s5_title: 5. How long we keep your data
privacidade.s5_body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active or for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes described above. Financial data may be retained for an additional period to comply with tax and legal obligations. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time, as described in the "Your rights" section.
privacidade.s6_body: Passwords are stored hashed (never in plain text), site traffic is encrypted via HTTPS, sessions use httpOnly cookies, and access to administrative data is restricted by password. No system is 100% risk-free, but we adopt technical and organizational measures appropriate to the scale of the service to protect your data against unauthorized access.
privacidade.s7_title: 7. Your rights as a data subject
privacidade.s7_intro: Under the LGPD, you have the right to:
privacidade.s7_li1: Confirm the existence of processing and access your data;
privacidade.s7_li2: Correct incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
privacidade.s7_li3: Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data;
privacidade.s7_li4: Request the portability of your data;
privacidade.s7_li5: Withdraw consent and request deletion of data processed based on it;
privacidade.s7_li6: Obtain information about who your data has been shared with.
privacidade.s7_outro: To exercise any of these rights, contact us through the channels listed in the "Contact" section.
privacidade.s8_body: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used. You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser settings, although this may affect some site features.
privacidade.s9_body: Questions, requests, or complaints about the processing of your personal data can be sent through the contact channels available on the site. If you're not satisfied with the response, you can also contact Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
privacidade.footer_copy: © 2026 TREM FORGE — every station, one journey
